newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen down in short-term, up in year.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen down in short-term, up in year.

text.p: Leading Danish share prices are expected to dip slightly by end-September 1997, before rallying again by the end of the year, according to a Reuter consensus of analysts' forecasts issued on Friday.

Eight analysts saw the Copenhagen bourse's top-20 KFX index rising to between 140 and 182 at the end of September this year, an average of 171-- compared to 172.00 on June 25 when most of the estimates were collected.
They forecast an average of 175 by end-December 1997 rising to 184 by end-June 1998.
The KFX index has risen some 30 percent so far in 1997.
It stood at 177.93 at 1200 GMT on Friday. --Soeren Linding Jakobsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969653
